name: Gasthof Neuhaus
beschreibung: The Gasthof Neuhaus in Kufstein, Tyrol, is a traditional inn rich in regional character. Located within the town of Kufstein, the Gasthof Neuhaus provides panoramic views of the surrounding mountain scenery. The atmosphere is characterised by Tyrolean hospitality and a warm, down-to-earth alpine ambience. Guests can indulge in delicious regional cuisine and relax in simply yet comfortably appointed rooms. The surroundings of the historic fortress town grant direct access to hiking trails and attractive destinations across the Kitzbühel Alps. Amenities include an open-air guest garden and ample parking space for arriving visitors.
